summary: draftControlledAckPayloadsV4 is a pure unsigned controlled TEST payload builder over the private authenticated source snapshot. It derives correlation/original/head/selection fields from retained data and computes receiver_journal_digest only as raw SHA256 of the exact retained genesis or output checkpoint bytes. Genesis-only snapshots produce no output draft; selected output retains manifest totals, while zero-selection uses the existing three null fields. The existing closed canonical payload schemas validate the drafts. An explicit UTC-microsecond draft timestamp is data, never a refreshed clock, native observation or durability claim. Immutable draft storage returns fresh byte copies. The same real signed journeys assert the complete joins and no ACK/host authority. The builder invokes no signer, journal write or live witness; prepareAck and reserveHost still refuse. Qualified runtime directory durability/live commit and installed host consume-once ACK/grant admission remain separate dependencies. Citations describe source and prepared assertions; runtime qualification and delivery need their own evidence.
title: Unsigned controlled ACK payloads commit to retained checkpoints
